capabilities: list open SuperProductivity tasks grouped by due date and project in a sidebar
quick-add tasks with @/#/+ shortcut syntax and autocomplete
edit task titles, due dates, and completion from Obsidian
drag tasks onto parents to re-create them as subtasks
reschedule all overdue tasks to today with one click
disambiguation: Not file syncing; 'sync' here means pushing task changes back and forth with the SuperProductivity app over its REST API.
extras: Desktop Obsidian only (talks to 127.0.0.1); the API token is stored in plain text in data.json, and the README warns about syncing that file; the plugin is not yet in the Community Plugins directory and needs manual installation; a standalone dataviewjs script is offered as a no-install alternative (requires the Dataview plugin).
motivation: The author originally built the functionality as a single dataviewjs code block before turning it into a plugin.
problem: Obsidian offers no way to see, add, or check off SuperProductivity tasks without switching to that app.

relations.evidence: View and edit your SuperProductivity tasks directly inside Obsidian, using SuperProductivity's local REST API

requires.name: SuperProductivity desktop app with local REST API enabled

summary: Task dashboard sidebar that views and edits tasks in the SuperProductivity desktop app via its local REST API.
